meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 装了这个技能后,Claude 会把 Discord 机器人通道接进项目:拷贝适配器、注册通道、安装固定版本依赖、构建并运行一条集成测试。然后带你创建 Discord 应用、粘贴 Bot Token,自动取得并保存凭据、重启服务,最后让你能在 Discord 私聊里和机器人对话。
howto.when: 当用户要求把 Discord 机器人接进项目、让机器人可在 Discord 频道或私聊里收发消息,或请求配置 Discord 集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 机器人接进项目
say.note: Claude 会开始执行添加 Discord 通道的流程。

say.text: 我想在 Discord 私聊里用这个机器人,帮我配置
say.note: 会引导你创建应用并粘贴 Bot Token。

say.text: 添加 Discord 频道集成
say.note: Claude 会复制适配器代码并运行测试。

howto.what_en: Claude adds a Discord bot integration: copies and registers the adapter, pins the dependency, builds, and runs a test. Then it guides you to create a bot and paste its token, saves credentials, restarts the service, and opens a DM channel.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a Discord bot, set up Discord chat, or configure a Discord integration.

say_en.text: Add the Discord bot integration to this project.
say_en.note: Claude starts the Discord channel setup flow.

say_en.text: I want to chat with this bot in Discord DMs — set it up.
say_en.note: Guides you through app creation and token paste.
Copies the adapter and runs the test.
